newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian weekly inflation holds steady at 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian weekly inflation holds steady at 0.3 pct.

text.p: Russian inflation was flat at 0.3 percent in the week ended March 24, on the previous week's level, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
Based on inflation rates so far this month, the committee estimated overall inflation for March would be 1.5 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended March 24 March 17
Basket of 37 basic goods and servies +0.2 0.2
Basket of 37 basic goods and servies +0.046 +1.116
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
